unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U13: Apply appellate superintendence and transfer safeguards without prejudging merits

facts.statement: Section17A Chairperson supervision/performance/case-information powers;case transfer within jurisdiction after parties notice/hearing;misbehaviour recommendation toCentralGovernment with reasons distinct from removal.

payload.title: Administrative supervision does not decide the borrower liability
payload.core_explanation_md:
The appellate Chairperson has the described superintendence and performance-review powers, including calling for case information and convening review meetings. These are different from deciding the merits of a particular debt application. A backlog report is not a recovery certificate.

The transfer power described in section 17A operates within its statutory scope and requires notice and hearing to the parties. A recommendation concerning an office-holder is also distinct from the competent authority final action. Preserve the grounds, notice, opportunity and order rather than treating administrative convenience as permission to omit the specified safeguards.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a performance-review meeting determine an individual claim?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Supervision and adjudication have distinct functions.

payload.stem_md: An administrative report lists a case as delayed. A lender records that as proof its claim has been adjudicated in full. Why is that unsound?

options.text_md: Delay reports automatically decide all applications
options.explanation_md: Administrative monitoring does not determine liability.

options.text_md: Only the borrower can identify an outstanding debt
options.explanation_md: Evidence can come from the parties and legal record.

options.text_md: A supervisory case report and a merits order are different records
options.explanation_md: The actual adjudicatory order is needed for its legal consequences.

options.text_md: The case disappears whenever a report is prepared
options.explanation_md: Reporting does not dispose of the application.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The actual adjudicatory order is needed for its legal consequences.

payload.stem_md: A proposed transfer falls within the statutory power but omits the described notice and hearing. Which correction follows?

options.text_md: Complete the party-notice and hearing process before the competent transfer decision
options.explanation_md: The source attaches safeguards to the transfer power.

options.text_md: Ignore safeguards whenever a transfer is convenient
options.explanation_md: Convenience does not replace the specified procedure.

options.text_md: Let the applicant privately transfer the court file
options.explanation_md: A party instruction is not the competent transfer order.

options.text_md: Treat transfer as automatic judgment for the bank
options.explanation_md: Transfer changes case allocation, not the substantive result.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The source attaches safeguards to the transfer power.
